title: Heat-grid
description: A grid of cells shaded by value, navigable by keyboard.

keyboard.action: Move into the grid (to the last focused cell) and out again.
Go to the first or last cell in the row.
Go to the first or last cell in the grid.

notes: Follows the WAI-ARIA grid pattern: `grid`, `row`, `columnheader`, `rowheader` and `gridcell`, with one Tab stop (roving tabindex).
Every cell is named with its row, column and value, so the colour is never needed to read it.
Values appear inside the cell on hover and focus, with text colour chosen per tint for contrast.
The grid scrolls sideways inside its own box on narrow screens instead of shrinking cells below 36 px.
